Business optimisation

Save worker-hours. Lift margins. Keep your sanity.

We watch how your business really runs, remove the repetitive work and give hours back to your people.

Find my hidden hoursTry the estimator

Illustrative flow of a typical manual process.

Chapter 01The problem

A day, lost in pieces.

Nobody wastes an afternoon on purpose. It leaks away in five-minute pieces — a number typed twice, a call to ask “did it happen?”, a file that cannot be found.

Add them up and half the day is spent keeping the business informed about itself.

  • Productive work4h 30m
  • Re-typing1h 15m
  • Chasing1h 00m
  • Waiting0h 45m
  • Searching0h 30m

Illustrative breakdown of an ordinary day.

Chapter 02Where hours hide

Six leaks we look for first.

1

Re-typing

The same number entered into three registers or sheets.

2

Chasing

Phone calls and messages to find out status.

3

Waiting

Approvals stuck with one person.

4

Searching

Files, bills and records hunted by hand.

5

Reporting

Hours spent building the weekly report.

6

Reconciling

Matching stock, cash or bank line by line.

Chapter 03Our loop

Map, measure, automate, sustain.

  1. 1

    Map

    Trace every step, handoff and wait.

  2. 2

    Measure

    Count the hours and errors each step costs.

  3. 3

    Automate

    Remove entries, chasing and approval delays.

  4. 4

    Sustain

    SOPs, training and monthly review keep the gains.

FAQ

Good questions

How does Sarvlekh save labour hours?

We map workflows, then automate repetitive entries, reminders, reports and approvals so staff spend time on work that needs judgement.

Will my team resist the change?

We design for the least-technical user and train on the floor, so adoption is quick.

Where do we start?

Start with a short discovery conversation. We identify the one or two workflows where automation pays back fastest.
